Size an air cylinder on bore for force at the available supply pressure and on stroke for the travel needed, then match the mounting and rod end to the machine. Quote the maker part number, or bore, stroke, mounting and port, and we will confirm the match before supply.

Quote the Parker part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every Parker part number in this range with its ratings. Ratings vary by size — check the row for the part you order.

Size an air cylinder on bore for force at the available supply pressure and on stroke for the travel needed, then match the mounting and rod end to the machine. Quote the maker part number, or bore, stroke, mounting and port, and we will confirm the match before supply.

Quote the Parker part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

Parker 4MA Series Tie Rod Pneumatic Cylinders, 1 1/2" Bore, 1P Part Numbers: 183 part numbers.

Specification

  • Type: Cylinder
  • Part numbers: 183

Sizes and part numbers

The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every Parker part number in this range with its ratings. Ratings vary by size — check the row for the part you order.

Sizing an air cylinder

Size an air cylinder on bore for force at the available supply pressure and on stroke for the travel needed, then match the mounting and rod end to the machine. Quote the maker part number, or bore, stroke, mounting and port, and we will confirm the match before supply.

How to order

Quote the Parker part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

Sizes and part numbers

The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every Parker part number in this range with its ratings. Ratings vary by size — check the row for the part you order.

Sizing an air cylinder

Size an air cylinder on bore for force at the available supply pressure and on stroke for the travel needed, then match the mounting and rod end to the machine. Quote the maker part number, or bore, stroke, mounting and port, and we will confirm the match before supply.

How to order

Quote the Parker part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

Parker 4MA Series Tie Rod Pneumatic Cylinders, 2 1/2" Bore, 1P Part Numbers: 189 part numbers.

Sizes and part numbers

The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every Parker part number in this range with its ratings. Ratings vary by size — check the row for the part you order.

Sizing an air cylinder

Size an air cylinder on bore for force at the available supply pressure and on stroke for the travel needed, then match the mounting and rod end to the machine. Quote the maker part number, or bore, stroke, mounting and port, and we will confirm the match before supply.

How to order

Quote the Parker part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

Sizes and part numbers

The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every Parker part number in this range with its ratings. Ratings vary by size — check the row for the part you order.

Sizing an air cylinder

Size an air cylinder on bore for force at the available supply pressure and on stroke for the travel needed, then match the mounting and rod end to the machine. Quote the maker part number, or bore, stroke, mounting and port, and we will confirm the match before supply.

How to order

Quote the Parker part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

Parker 4MA Series Tie Rod Pneumatic Cylinders, Full Male, 2" Bore, 1P Part Numbers: 202 part numbers.

Specification

  • Type: Cylinder
  • Part numbers: 202

Sizes and part numbers

The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every Parker part number in this range with its ratings. Ratings vary by size — check the row for the part you order.

Sizing an air cylinder

Size an air cylinder on bore for force at the available supply pressure and on stroke for the travel needed, then match the mounting and rod end to the machine. Quote the maker part number, or bore, stroke, mounting and port, and we will confirm the match before supply.

How to order

Quote the Parker part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

Parker 4MA Series Tie Rod Pneumatic Cylinders, Full Male, 2 1/2" Bore, 1P Part Numbers: 165 part numbers.

Specification

  • Type: Cylinder
  • Part numbers: 165

Sizes and part numbers

The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every Parker part number in this range with its ratings. Ratings vary by size — check the row for the part you order.

Sizing an air cylinder

Size an air cylinder on bore for force at the available supply pressure and on stroke for the travel needed, then match the mounting and rod end to the machine. Quote the maker part number, or bore, stroke, mounting and port, and we will confirm the match before supply.

How to order

Quote the Parker part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

Sizes and part numbers

Size an air cylinder on bore for force at the available supply pressure and on stroke for the travel needed, then match the mounting and rod end to the machine. Quote the maker part number, or bore, stroke, mounting and port, and we will confirm the match before supply.

Parker 4MA Series Tie Rod Pneumatic Cylinders, Lip Seal Piston, 2" Bore, 1P Part Numbers: 218 part numbers.

Specification

  • Type: Cylinder
  • Part numbers: 218

Sizes and part numbers

The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every Parker part number in this range with its ratings. Ratings vary by size — check the row for the part you order.

Sizing an air cylinder

Size an air cylinder on bore for force at the available supply pressure and on stroke for the travel needed, then match the mounting and rod end to the machine. Quote the maker part number, or bore, stroke, mounting and port, and we will confirm the match before supply.

How to order

Quote the Parker part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

Sizes and part numbers

The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every Parker part number in this range with its ratings. Ratings vary by size — check the row for the part you order.

Sizing an air cylinder

Size an air cylinder on bore for force at the available supply pressure and on stroke for the travel needed, then match the mounting and rod end to the machine. Quote the maker part number, or bore, stroke, mounting and port, and we will confirm the match before supply.

How to order

Quote the Parker part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

Parker 4MA Series Tie Rod Pneumatic Cylinders, Lip Seal Piston, 3 1/4" Bore, 1P Part Numbers: 171 part numbers.

Specification

  • Type: Cylinder
  • Part numbers: 171

Sizes and part numbers

The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every Parker part number in this range with its ratings. Ratings vary by size — check the row for the part you order.

Sizing an air cylinder

Size an air cylinder on bore for force at the available supply pressure and on stroke for the travel needed, then match the mounting and rod end to the machine. Quote the maker part number, or bore, stroke, mounting and port, and we will confirm the match before supply.

How to order

Quote the Parker part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

Parker 4MA Series Tie Rod Pneumatic Cylinders, Lip Seal Piston, 4" Bore, 1P Part Numbers: 130 part numbers.

Sizes and part numbers

The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every Parker part number in this range with its ratings. Ratings vary by size — check the row for the part you order.

Sizing an air cylinder

Size an air cylinder on bore for force at the available supply pressure and on stroke for the travel needed, then match the mounting and rod end to the machine. Quote the maker part number, or bore, stroke, mounting and port, and we will confirm the match before supply.

How to order

Quote the Parker part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

Parker 4MA Series Tie Rod Pneumatic Cylinders, Small Male, 2 1/2" Bore, 1P Part Numbers: 146 part numbers.

Specification

  • Type: Cylinder
  • Part numbers: 146

Sizes and part numbers

The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every Parker part number in this range with its ratings. Ratings vary by size — check the row for the part you order.

Sizing an air cylinder

Size an air cylinder on bore for force at the available supply pressure and on stroke for the travel needed, then match the mounting and rod end to the machine. Quote the maker part number, or bore, stroke, mounting and port, and we will confirm the match before supply.

How to order

Quote the Parker part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

Parker 4MA Series Tie Rod Pneumatic Cylinders, Small Male, 3 1/4" Bore, 1P Part Numbers: 155 part numbers.

Specification

  • Part numbers: 155

Sizes and part numbers

The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every Parker part number in this range with its ratings. Ratings vary by size — check the row for the part you order.

Sizing an air cylinder

Size an air cylinder on bore for force at the available supply pressure and on stroke for the travel needed, then match the mounting and rod end to the machine. Quote the maker part number, or bore, stroke, mounting and port, and we will confirm the match before supply.

How to order

Quote the Parker part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

Parker 4MA Series Tie Rod Pneumatic Cylinders, 2-1/2 Inch Bore: 969 part numbers.

Specification

  • Type: Cylinder
  • Part numbers: 969

Sizes and part numbers

The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every Parker part number in this range with its ratings. Ratings vary by size — check the row for the part you order.

Sizing an air cylinder

Size an air cylinder on bore for force at the available supply pressure and on stroke for the travel needed, then match the mounting and rod end to the machine. Quote the maker part number, or bore, stroke, mounting and port, and we will confirm the match before supply.

How to order

Quote the Parker part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

Parker 4MA Series Tie Rod Pneumatic Cylinders, Lipseals And Magnetic Ring, 2 1/2" Bore: 958 part numbers.

Sizes and part numbers

The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every Parker part number in this range with its ratings. Ratings vary by size — check the row for the part you order.

Sizing an air cylinder

Size an air cylinder on bore for force at the available supply pressure and on stroke for the travel needed, then match the mounting and rod end to the machine. Quote the maker part number, or bore, stroke, mounting and port, and we will confirm the match before supply.

How to order

Quote the Parker part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

Sizes and part numbers

The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every Parker part number in this range with its ratings. Ratings vary by size — check the row for the part you order.

Sizing an air cylinder

Size an air cylinder on bore for force at the available supply pressure and on stroke for the travel needed, then match the mounting and rod end to the machine. Quote the maker part number, or bore, stroke, mounting and port, and we will confirm the match before supply.

Sizes and part numbers

The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every Parker part number in this range with its ratings. Ratings vary by size — check the row for the part you order.

Size an air cylinder on bore for force at the available supply pressure and on stroke for the travel needed, then match the mounting and rod end to the machine. Quote the maker part number, or bore, stroke, mounting and port, and we will confirm the match before supply.

How to order

Quote the Parker part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

Parker 4MA Series Tie Rod Pneumatic Cylinders, 3-1/4 Inch Bore: 796 part numbers.

Specification

  • Type: Cylinder
  • Part numbers: 796

Sizes and part numbers

The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every Parker part number in this range with its ratings. Ratings vary by size — check the row for the part you order.

Sizing an air cylinder

Size an air cylinder on bore for force at the available supply pressure and on stroke for the travel needed, then match the mounting and rod end to the machine. Quote the maker part number, or bore, stroke, mounting and port, and we will confirm the match before supply.

How to order

Quote the Parker part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

Size an air cylinder on bore for force at the available supply pressure and on stroke for the travel needed, then match the mounting and rod end to the machine. Quote the maker part number, or bore, stroke, mounting and port, and we will confirm the match before supply.

Size an air cylinder on bore for force at the available supply pressure and on stroke for the travel needed, then match the mounting and rod end to the machine. Quote the maker part number, or bore, stroke, mounting and port, and we will confirm the match before supply.

Sizes and part numbers

The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every Parker part number in this range with its ratings. Ratings vary by size — check the row for the part you order.

Sizing an air cylinder

Size an air cylinder on bore for force at the available supply pressure and on stroke for the travel needed, then match the mounting and rod end to the machine. Quote the maker part number, or bore, stroke, mounting and port, and we will confirm the match before supply.

How to order

Quote the Parker part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

Sizes and part numbers

The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every Parker part number in this range with its ratings. Ratings vary by size — check the row for the part you order.

Sizing an air cylinder

Size an air cylinder on bore for force at the available supply pressure and on stroke for the travel needed, then match the mounting and rod end to the machine. Quote the maker part number, or bore, stroke, mounting and port, and we will confirm the match before supply.

How to order

Quote the Parker part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

Sizes and part numbers

The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every Parker part number in this range with its ratings. Ratings vary by size — check the row for the part you order.

Sizing an air cylinder

Size an air cylinder on bore for force at the available supply pressure and on stroke for the travel needed, then match the mounting and rod end to the machine. Quote the maker part number, or bore, stroke, mounting and port, and we will confirm the match before supply.

How to order

Quote the Parker part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

Quote the Parker part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

Quote the Parker part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

products.descriptionLong:
Parker SRM Series Air Cylinders, 1-1/2 Inch Bore: 336 part numbers.

Specification

  • Type: Air Cylinder
  • Single Acting/double Acting: Double Acting
  • Part numbers: 336

Sizes and part numbers

The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every Parker part number in this range with its ratings. Ratings vary by size — check the row for the part you order.

Sizing an air cylinder

Size an air cylinder on bore for force at the available supply pressure and on stroke for the travel needed, then match the mounting and rod end to the machine. Quote the maker part number, or bore, stroke, mounting and port, and we will confirm the match before supply.

How to order

Quote the Parker part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

products.descriptionLong:
Parker SRM Series Air Cylinders, 1-1/4 Inch Bore: 147 part numbers.

Specification

  • Type: Air Cylinder
  • Single Acting/double Acting: Double Acting
  • Part numbers: 147

Sizes and part numbers

The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every Parker part number in this range with its ratings. Ratings vary by size — check the row for the part you order.

Sizing an air cylinder

Size an air cylinder on bore for force at the available supply pressure and on stroke for the travel needed, then match the mounting and rod end to the machine. Quote the maker part number, or bore, stroke, mounting and port, and we will confirm the match before supply.

How to order

Quote the Parker part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.
